subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97a28ab81dc1ff36fe9b6cea3091b76b9fc17cdf7c6366737a0feaa8f282dd78.png]
solution:
For this question, the logic is given below-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97a28ab81dc1ff36fe9b6cea3091b76b9fc17cdf7c6366737a0feaa8f282dd78.png] 

In (I) and (iii) images of dice, two faces (1 & 2) are common.

So, the face showing 3 is opposite to the face showing 4.

Hence, **Option (4)** is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Dices are of two types:

 
• Standard Dice
 
• Non-Standard Dice.

 
• Dice has:-

 
• faces = 6
 
• sides = 12
 
• corners = 8 

 
• Two opposite faces are never seen together.
 
• Adjacent faces are never opposite to each other.​

When two positions of the same dice are given with one face as the common:

1. We take the common letter and move either in a Clockwise or Anti-clockwise direction.

2. The faces that come in this process are opposite each other in the same order.
